name: gallery-01
title: Gallery 01 - An Image Grid That Opens One At Full Size
description: A grid of images where each tile is a real button that opens the lightbox at full size, with a caption under every tile and a count on the set. The tile's accessible name is composed from the caller's own alt and caption and never from a word Prism chose, and an href on a tile is refused because a tile cannot be both a trigger and a link. The four control labels are the caller's.
